answer:
The average Case Review Hours per case for Business and Financial Operations cases (SOC code beginning with '13') whose Start Month falls in 2024 is **3.79**.

This uses the governed `case_review_hours` definition (CRH = base_hours + position_hours × headCt from each case's single governing review rule, or the Default Review Schedule of 3.50/0.50 when no rule matches), averaged over the filtered cases and rounded only at reporting.

```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_crh
FROM main.cases c JOIN (
 WITH ca AS (
  SELECT c2.filekey, CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
   pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
   CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent, substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
   cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
  JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v
    ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
 )
 SELECT ca.filekey, ca.monthly_volume_band, r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
  COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours, COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
 FROM ca LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
  ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
  AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
  AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
  AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
  AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
  AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
 QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.filekey ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  r.rule_id ASC) = 1
) g ON g.filekey = c.filekey
WHERE substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) = '13'
  AND year(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = 2024
```

The load is the sum of CRH (base_hours + position_hours × headCt) from each case's governing review rule (or the 3.50/0.50 default), over the employer's cases whose Start Month is December 2023, rounded to 2 decimals only at reporting.

```sql
WITH g AS (
  WITH ca AS (
    SELECT c2.filekey, CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
      pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
      CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent, substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
      cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
      CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM main.cases c2
    JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
    JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v
      ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
  )
  SELECT ca.filekey, ca.monthly_volume_band, r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
    COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours, COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM ca LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
    AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
    AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
    AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
    AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
    AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.filekey ORDER BY
    (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
    r.rule_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT c.homefirm AS employer,
  ROUND(SUM(g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM main.cases c
JOIN g ON g.filekey = c.filekey
WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
GROUP BY c.homefirm
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY employer_review_load DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

The calculation involves:

```sql
WITH case_attrs AS (
    SELECT 
        c.filekey,
        c.homefirm,
        c.headct,
        c.visacls,
        c.h1bdep,
        SUBSTRING(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        cw.wsstate,
        SUBSTRING(c.beginday, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(c.beginday, 7, 4) AS start_month,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wagetrack = pw.trackno
),
emcv AS (
    SELECT 
        homefirm,
        start_month,
        COUNT(*) AS emcv_count
    FROM case_attrs
    GROUP BY homefirm, start_month
),
case_with_band AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.emcv_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN e.emcv_count >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END AS mvb
    FROM case_attrs ca
    JOIN emcv e ON ca.homefirm = e.homefirm AND ca.start_month = e.start_month
),
rule_match AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.filekey,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM case_with_band cb
    CROSS JOIN review_schedule rs
    WHERE 
        (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = cb.visacls) AND
        (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = cb.wage_level) AND
        (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = cb.h1bdep) AND
        (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = cb.soc_major_group) AND
        (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = cb.wsstate) AND
        (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = cb.mvb)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        rule_id,
        base_hours,
        position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY filekey ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM rule_match
),

    SELECT 
        cb.filekey,
        cb.homefirm,
        cb.start_month,
        cb.headct,
        COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) * cb.headct AS crh
    FROM case_with_band cb
    LEFT JOIN governing g ON cb.filekey = g.filekey AND g.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    homefirm,
    ROUND(SUM(crh), 2) AS erl
FROM case_crh

LIMIT 5;
```

answer:
The Employer Review Load for Ernst & Young U.S. LLP for 2024 is **141.20** reviewer-hours.

This is computed from 49 cases (9 starting in January 2024, 40 starting in June 2024). Each case's CRH is determined by its governing review rule (or the default schedule of 3.50 + 0.50×headCt when no rule matches). One case (I-200-23355-583815) matched no rule and received the default charge.

```sql
WITH case_attrs AS (
    SELECT 
        c.filekey,
        c.visaCls,
        c.h1bDep,
        substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) as soc_major_group,
        c.headct,
        (substr(c.beginday, 7, 4) || '-' || substr(c.beginday, 4, 2)) as start_month,
        cw.wsstate,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' as wage_level,
        CASE 
            WHEN emcv.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN emcv.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN emcv.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN emcv.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END as vol_band
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wagetrack = pw.trackno
    JOIN (
        SELECT homefirm, (substr(beginday, 7, 4) || '-' || substr(beginday, 4, 2)) as sm, COUNT(*) as emcv
        FROM cases
        WHERE homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
        GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) emcv ON c.homefirm = emcv.homefirm AND (substr(c.beginday, 7, 4) || '-' || substr(c.beginday, 4, 2)) = emcv.sm
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
      AND substr(c.beginday, 7, 4) = '2024'
),
matches AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.filekey,
        ca.headct,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) as specificity
    FROM case_attrs ca
    CROSS JOIN review_schedule rs
    WHERE 
        (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = ca.visaCls)
        AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR (rs.wage_level = ca.wage_level AND ca.wage_level IS NOT NULL))
        AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR (rs.h1b_dependent = ca.h1bDep AND ca.h1bDep IS NOT NULL))
        AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR (rs.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group AND ca.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL))
        AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR (rs.worksite_state = ca.wsstate AND ca.wsstate IS NOT NULL))
```

The average Case Review Hours per case for Business and Financial Operations cases (SOC major group '13') whose Start Month falls in 2024 is **3.79** (over 62 cases).

Each case's CRH is computed from its governing review rule (most specific matching rule, ties to lowest rule_id; default 3.50 + 0.50×headCt when no rule matches): CRH = base_hours + position_hours × headCt.

```sql
WITH ca AS (

   pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,

   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
  JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v
```

answer:
The Employer Wage Assurance Score (EWAS) for **WIPRO LIMITED** for the Start Month December 2023 is **19.10** (a "Thin" tier score, headcount-weighted CWAS across its cases starting in that month).

```sql
SELECT ROUND(
  SUM((0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((w.aow - w.apw) / w.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
     + 0.3 * CASE w.wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END) * w.headct)
  / SUM(w.headct), 2) AS ewas
FROM (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct, c.beginday,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
) w
WHERE w.homefirm = 'WIPRO LIMITED'
  AND date_trunc('month', strptime(w.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
```

```sql

   cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2

  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
  JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v
```

The total Employer Review Load for 2024 would increase by **14.85 reviewer-hours**.

Reasoning:
- Rule 5 currently has `position_hours = 0.85`; raising it to 1.00 adds `0.15 × headCt` to the CRH of every case whose governing rule is rule 5.
- Changing `position_hours` does not affect rule matching (governance is by specificity then rule_id), so the set of cases governed by rule 5 is unchanged.
- 66 cases with Start Month in 2024 are governed by rule 5, with total `headCt = 99`.
- Increase = 0.15 × 99 = **14.85**.

```sql
   pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,

   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band,
```

answer:
The calculation is verified. The EWAS for WIPRO LIMITED in December 2023 is **19.10**.

```sql
WITH case_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.headCt,
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) AS offered_amt,
        pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' AS offered_unit,
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) AS pw_amt,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' AS pw_unit,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS pw_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wageTrack
    WHERE c.homeFirm = 'WIPRO LIMITED'
      AND CAST(SUBSTRING(c.beginDay, 4, 2) AS INT) = 12
      AND CAST(SUBSTRING(c.beginDay, 7, 4) AS INT) = 2023
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        filekey,
        headCt,
        CASE offered_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN offered_amt*2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN offered_amt*52 WHEN 'Month' THEN offered_amt*12 ELSE offered_amt END AS aow,
        CASE pw_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN pw_amt*2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN pw_amt*52 WHEN 'Month' THEN pw_amt*12 ELSE pw_amt END AS apw,
        pw_level
    FROM case_data
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(headCt * (0.7 * (100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
                    + 0.3 * (CASE pw_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END)))
        / SUM(headCt),
    2) AS ewas
FROM scored
```

For cases with a Start Month of January 2024, the average Case Review Hours per case is:

- **H-1B dependent ('Yes'): 5.61**
- **Non-dependent ('No'): 4.08**

The CRH for each case is computed from its governing review rule (most specific matching rule, ties by lowest rule_id; default 3.50/0.50 when none matches) as `base_hours + position_hours × headCt`, then averaged within each dependency group and rounded to 2 decimals.

```sql
WITH ca AS (
  SELECT c2.filekey, CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
   pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
   CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent, substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
   cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
  JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v
    ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
),
g AS (
  SELECT ca.filekey, ca.h1b_dependent,
   COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours, COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM ca LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
   ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.filekey ORDER BY
   (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
   r.rule_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct) FILTER (WHERE g.h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct) FILTER (WHERE g.h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM main.cases c
JOIN g ON g.filekey = c.filekey
WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2024-01-01';
```

Here's the reasoning:
1. I identified 247 cases with a Start Month of December 2023 (beginDay in DD/MM/YYYY format with month=12, year=2023)
2. For each case, I computed the Monthly Volume Band from the employer's EMCV in that month
3. I matched each case against all 496 rules in the review_schedule, where a rule matches when every non-NULL criterion equals the case's value (and NULL case values only match NULL criteria)
4. The governing rule is the most specific match (most non-NULL criteria), with ties broken by lowest rule_id
5. 25 cases matched no rule and fell to the Default Review Schedule (base_hours=3.50, position_hours=0.50)
6. Total CRH = 1112.05, Default CRH = 104.00, giving 104.00/1112.05 × 100 = 9.35%

```sql
WITH dec2023 AS (
    SELECT c.filekey, c.visaCls, c.h1bDep, c.soccd, c.headct, c.homefirm,
           cw.wsState, cw.wageTrack,
           pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level

    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wageTrack = pw.trackno
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(c.beginday, 4, 2) AS INT) = 12 
      AND CAST(SUBSTRING(c.beginday, 7, 4) AS INT) = 2023
),
emcv AS (
    SELECT homefirm, COUNT(*) AS emcv_count
    FROM dec2023
    GROUP BY homefirm
),
case_attrs AS (
    SELECT d.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.emcv_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN e.emcv_count >= 15 THEN '15+'

        SUBSTRING(d.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major
    FROM dec2023 d
    JOIN emcv e ON d.homefirm = e.homefirm
),
rule_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM case_attrs ca
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visaCls)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR (r.wage_level = ca.wage_level AND ca.wage_level IS NOT NULL))
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR (r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1bDep AND ca.h1bDep IS NOT NULL))
```

The Employer Wage Assurance Score of INFOSYS LIMITED for 2024 is **18.00**.

All 11 cases have offered wages exactly equal to the prevailing wage (WHR = 0), so headroom points are 0 for every case. The score is driven entirely by the wage level component (0.3 × level points), weighted by headcount.

```sql
WITH case_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.headCt,
        CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) AS offered_raw,
        pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' AS offered_unit,
        CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) AS prevailing_raw,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' AS prevailing_unit,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homeFirm = 'INFOSYS LIMITED'
      AND substr(c.beginday, 7, 4) = '2024'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        filekey,
        headCt,
        offered_raw * CASE offered_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END AS aow,
        prevailing_raw * CASE prevailing_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END AS apw,
        wage_level
    FROM case_data
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        filekey,
        headCt,
        0.7 * (100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
        + 0.3 * (CASE wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END) AS cwas
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(cwas * headCt) * 1.0 / SUM(headCt), 2) AS ewas
FROM final
```

The average Case Wage Assurance Score (CWAS) for Business and Financial Operations cases (SOC code starting with '13') whose Start Month falls in 2024 is **55.13**.

The query computes each case's CWAS using the governed definition (0.7 × Headroom Points + 0.3 × Level Points, with WHR = (AOW − APW)/APW and annualized wages from the prevailing-wage records), filters to SOC codes beginning with '13' and Start Months in 2024, then takes the simple average rounded to 2 decimals.

```sql
SELECT ROUND(AVG(
  0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((w.aow - w.apw) / w.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
  + 0.3 * CASE w.wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END
), 2) AS avg_cwas
FROM (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.soccd, c.beginday,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
) w
WHERE w.soccd LIKE '13%'
  AND date_trunc('month', strptime(w.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND date_trunc('month', strptime(w.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) < DATE '2025-01-01';
```

The increase is 14.85 reviewer-hours.

**Reasoning:**
- Rule 5 currently has `position_hours = 0.85`. Raising it to 1.00 increases each governed case's CRH by `(1.00 − 0.85) × headCt = 0.15 × headCt`.
- Changing `position_hours` does not affect rule matching (governing rule is chosen by specificity then lowest rule_id), so the set of cases governed by rule 5 is unchanged.
- For the year 2024 (Start Month = calendar month of `beginday`), 66 cases are governed by rule 5 with a combined `headCt` of 99.
- Increase = 0.15 × 99 = **14.85** reviewer-hours.

```sql
WITH ca AS (
  SELECT c2.filekey, CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
   pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
   CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent, substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
   cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
  JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v
    ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
),
g AS (
  SELECT ca.filekey, r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
    COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours, COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM ca LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
    AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
    AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
    AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
    AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
    AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.filekey ORDER BY
    (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
    r.rule_id ASC) = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM((1.00 - g.position_hours) * c.headct), 2) AS increase
FROM main.cases c
JOIN g ON g.filekey = c.filekey
WHERE g.governing_rule_id = 5
  AND year(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = 2024
```

```sql
WITH w AS (
```

The Employer Review Load is the sum of each case's Case Review Hours (CRH = base_hours + position_hours × headCt), where the base/position hours come from the case's Governing Review Rule (most specific matching rule, ties by lowest rule_id) or the Default Review Schedule (3.50 / 0.50) when no rule matches. The Monthly Volume Band is derived from the employer's case count per Start Month.

```sql
WITH ms AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.visaCls, c.h1bDep, substr(c.SocCd,1,2) AS soc_major, c.headCt,
         cw.wsState,
         pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
         strftime(strptime(c.beginDay, '%d/%m/%Y'), '%Y-%m') AS start_month
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockKey = c.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wageTrack
  WHERE c.homeFirm = 'Microsoft Corporation'
),
emcv AS (SELECT start_month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ms GROUP BY start_month),
band AS (
  SELECT start_month,
    CASE WHEN cnt=1 THEN '1' WHEN cnt BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
         WHEN cnt BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS mvb FROM emcv
),
case_attrs AS (SELECT m.*, b.mvb FROM ms m JOIN band b ON b.start_month = m.start_month),
matches AS (
  SELECT ca.filekey, r.rule_id, r.base_hours, r.position_hours,
    (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
  FROM case_attrs ca
  JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visaCls)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1bDep)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.wsState)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.mvb)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.filekey ORDER BY m.specificity DESC, m.rule_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM matches m
),
governing AS (
  SELECT filekey, base_hours, position_hours FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
crh AS (
  SELECT ca.filekey, ca.start_month,
         (COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) * ca.headCt) AS crh
  FROM case_attrs ca
  LEFT JOIN governing g ON g.filekey = ca.filekey
)
SELECT start_month, ROUND(SUM(crh), 2) AS load
FROM crh
GROUP BY start_month
ORDER BY start_month ASC
```

```sql
WITH ca AS (

  FROM main.cases c2
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey

  JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v

    AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
    AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)

)
```

The CWAS was computed per the governed definition: 0.7 × Headroom Points (from the Wage Headroom Ratio, capped at 0.40) + 0.3 × Level Points (I=25, II=50, III=75, IV=100, NULL=50), with wages annualized by unit (Hour×2080, Week×52, Month×12, Year×1), and the Start Month derived from `beginday` (DD/MM/YYYY) truncated to the month.

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT w.filekey, w.beginday,
    0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((w.aow - w.apw) / w.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
      + 0.3 * CASE w.wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END AS cwas
  FROM (
    SELECT c.filekey, c.beginday,
      pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
      CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
        * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
      CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
        * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
    FROM main.cases c
    JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  ) w
) w
WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(w.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND w.cwas >= 75
```

Among employers with at least five cases starting in December 2023, the top five by Employer Wage Assurance Score (headcount-weighted CWAS, per the governed EWAS definition) are:

The query filters cases to Start Month = December 2023 (from `beginday` DD/MM/YYYY), groups by the exact `homefirm` text, requires ≥ 5 cases, computes the unrounded headcount-weighted CWAS, and rounds only the reported score.

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct, c.beginday,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
)
SELECT w.homefirm AS employer,
  ROUND(SUM((0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((w.aow - w.apw) / w.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
     + 0.3 * CASE w.wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END) * w.headct)
  / SUM(w.headct), 2) AS ewas
FROM w
GROUP BY w.homefirm
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY ewas DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

The average Case Wage Assurance Score per case for Business and Financial Operations cases (SOC code beginning with '13') whose Start Month falls in 2024 is **55.13**.

```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,
    (
      CAST(
        regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '\$', ''),
          ',', ''
        ) AS DOUBLE
      )
    ) * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
         WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
         WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
         WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
         WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
       END AS aow,
    (
      CAST(
        regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''),
          ',', ''
        ) AS DOUBLE
      )
    ) * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
         WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
         WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
         WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
         WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
       END AS apw,
    CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level'
      WHEN 'I' THEN 25
      WHEN 'II' THEN 50
      WHEN 'III' THEN 75
      WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
      ELSE 50
    END AS level_points
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.soccd LIKE '13%'
    AND substr(c.beginDay, 7, 4) = '2024'
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    filekey,
    level_points,
    100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS headroom_points
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(0.7 * headroom_points + 0.3 * level_points), 2) AS avg_cwas
FROM scored
```

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct, c.beginday,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,

  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
```

```sql
WITH base_cases AS (

        c.h1bDep,
        c.visaCls,
        SUBSTRING(c.SocCd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        c.headCt,
        c.homeFirm,
        cw.wsState,

    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wageTrack = pw.trackno
    WHERE c.beginDay LIKE '%/01/2024'
      AND c.h1bDep IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
emcv AS (
    SELECT homeFirm, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM cases
    WHERE beginDay LIKE '%/01/2024'
    GROUP BY homeFirm
),
cases_with_band AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.cnt = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN e.cnt BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN e.cnt BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN e.cnt >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM base_cases bc
    JOIN emcv e ON bc.homeFirm = e.homeFirm
),
rule_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        cwb.filekey,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM cases_with_band cwb
    JOIN review_schedule rs
        ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = cwb.visaCls)
        AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = cwb.wage_level)
        AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = cwb.h1bDep)
        AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = cwb.soc_major_group)
        AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = cwb.wsState)
        AND (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = cwb.monthly_volume_band)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        base_hours,
        position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY filekey ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM rule_matches
),
final AS (
    SELECT 
        cwb.filekey,
        cwb.h1bDep,
        cwb.headCt,
        COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
        COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
    FROM cases_with_band cwb
    LEFT JOIN governing g ON cwb.filekey = g.filekey AND g.rn = 1
)

FROM final;
```

The H-1B dependent cases have notably higher average review hours, which makes sense as the review schedule rules for dependent cases tend to carry higher base and per-position hour charges.

```sql
WITH case_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.filekey,
        c.visaCls,
        c.h1bDep,
        c.SocCd,
        c.beginDay,
        c.headCt,
        c.homeFirm,
        (SUBSTRING(c.beginDay, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING(c.beginDay, 4, 2)) as start_month,
        SUBSTRING(c.SocCd, 1, 2) as soc_major_group,
        cw.wsState,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' as wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wageTrack = pw.trackno
    WHERE SUBSTRING(c.beginDay, 4, 2) = '01' AND SUBSTRING(c.beginDay, 7, 4) = '2024'
),
emcv AS (
    SELECT homeFirm, start_month, COUNT(*) as emcv_count
    FROM case_data
    GROUP BY homeFirm, start_month
),
case_with_band AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.emcv_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN e.emcv_count >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END as monthly_volume_band
    FROM case_data cd
    JOIN emcv e ON cd.homeFirm = e.homeFirm AND cd.start_month = e.start_month
),
rule_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        cwb.filekey,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as specificity
    FROM case_with_band cwb
    JOIN review_schedule rs
        ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = cwb.visaCls)
        AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = cwb.wage_level)
        AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = cwb.h1bDep)
        AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = cwb.soc_major_group)
        AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = cwb.wsState)
        AND (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = cwb.monthly_volume_band)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        base_hours,
        position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY filekey ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC) as rn
    FROM rule_matches
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cwb.h1bDep = 'Yes' THEN COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) * cwb.headCt END), 2) as avg_crh_yes,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cwb.h1bDep = 'No' THEN COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) * cwb.headCt END), 2) as avg_crh_no
FROM case_with_band cwb
LEFT JOIN governing g ON cwb.filekey = g.filekey AND g.rn = 1
WHERE cwb.h1bDep IN ('Yes', 'No')
```

            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN e.emcv_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN e.emcv_count >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END as monthly_volume_band
    FROM case_data cd
    JOIN emcv e ON cd.homeFirm = e.homeFirm AND cd.start_month = e.start_month
),
rule_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        cwb.filekey,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as specificity
    FROM case_with_band cwb
    JOIN review_schedule rs
        ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = cwb.visaCls)
        AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = cwb.wage_level)
        AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = cwb.h1bDep)
        AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = cwb.soc_major_group)
        AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = cwb.wsState)
        AND (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = cwb.monthly_volume_band)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        base_hours,
        position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY filekey ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC) as rn
    FROM rule_matches
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cwb.h1bDep = 'Yes' THEN COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) * cwb.headCt END), 2) as avg_crh_yes,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cwb.h1bDep = 'No' THEN COALESCE(g.base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(g.position_hours, 0.50) * cwb.headCt END), 2) as avg_crh_no
FROM case_with_band cwb
LEFT JOIN governing g ON cwb.filekey = g.filekey AND g.rn = 1
WHERE cwb.h1bDep IN ('Yes', 'No')

For cases with a Start Month of January 2024, the average Case Review Hours per case is:

The query computes each case's CRH from its governing review rule (most specific matching rule, ties to lowest rule_id, else the default 3.50/0.50), filters to Start Month = January 2024, and averages by H-1B dependency status (NULL cases excluded).

```sql
WITH ca AS (
  SELECT c2.filekey, CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
   pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
   CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent, substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
   cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
  JOIN (SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv FROM main.cases GROUP BY 1, 2) v
    ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
),
g AS (
  SELECT ca.filekey, ca.h1b_dependent,
   COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours, COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM ca LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
   ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)

   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.filekey ORDER BY
   (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
   r.rule_id ASC) = 1
)
```

```sql
WITH case_wages AS (

        ) AS aow,

                WHEN json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') = 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') = 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') = 'Year' THEN 1
                ELSE 1
            END
        ) * (
            REPLACE(REPLACE(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'), 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::DOUBLE
```

| Employer | EWAS |
|---|---|
| Ernst & Young U.S. LLP | 75.25 |
| Amazon Development Center U.S., Inc. | 69.24 |
| Amazon.com Services LLC | 68.72 |
| Google LLC | 54.34 |
| COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS US CORP | 47.35 |

EWAS is the headcount-weighted average of the per-case Wage Assurance Score (CWAS = 0.7 × Headroom Points + 0.3 × Level Points), computed over each employer's cases whose Start Month (calendar month of `beginday`) is December 2023, keeping only employers with ≥ 5 such cases.

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
)
SELECT homefirm,
  ROUND(SUM((0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
       + 0.3 * CASE wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END) * headct)
  / SUM(headct), 2) AS ewas
FROM w
GROUP BY homefirm
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY ewas DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

For cases with a Start Month of January 2024, the average Case Wage Assurance Score (CWAS) is:

- **H-1B dependent ('Yes'): 33.77**
- **Non-dependent ('No'): 42.60**

The non-dependent cases score higher on average, consistent with the expectation that H-1B-dependent employers tend to offer wages closer to (or below) prevailing levels.

Method: I used the governed CWAS definition — AOW and APW parsed from the wage JSON (with unit annualization factors), WHR = (AOW − APW)/APW, Headroom Points = 100 × min(max(WHR, 0), 0.40)/0.40, Level Points (I=25, II=50, III=75, IV=100, NULL=50), CWAS = 0.7×Headroom + 0.3×Level — computed unrounded per case, filtered to Start Month = January 2024 via `date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))`, then averaged per dependency group and rounded only at reporting.

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.h1bdep,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND c.h1bdep IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
scored AS (
  SELECT h1bdep,
    0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
      + 0.3 * CASE wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END AS cwas
  FROM w
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN h1bdep = 'Yes' THEN cwas END), 2) AS avg_cwas_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN h1bdep = 'No' THEN cwas END), 2) AS avg_cwas_no
FROM scored;
```

The total Return Handling Charge for customer CUS00032 for returns in January 2025 is **1037.41**.

This was computed using the governed `total_return_handling_charge` metric: for each return, the applying rule was selected by matching all criteria (segment, channel, category, primary reason, item condition, and the customer's monthly return count band) with highest specificity (ties broken by lowest rule_id), falling back to the Standard Handling Charge (15.00 + 5.0%) when no rule matched; RHC = flat_charge + charge_pct/100 × unit_value, summed over the customer's January 2025 returns (by `revdate`) and rounded only at the end.

```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE ar.flat_charge END
    + CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.0 ELSE ar.charge_pct END / 100.0 * CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM main.returns r
JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT x.casenum, x.rule_id, x.flat_charge, x.charge_pct, x.specificity FROM (
    SELECT r2.casenum, cr.rule_id, cr.flat_charge, cr.charge_pct,
      (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r2.casenum ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM main.returns r2
    JOIN main.orders o2 ON o2.txnnum = r2.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN main.customers c2 ON c2.profilenum = o2.buyerlink
    JOIN main.products p2 ON p2.itemcode = r2.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment q2 ON q2.inspectref = r2.casenum
    JOIN (SELECT o3.buyerlink AS cust, substr(r3.revdate, 1, 7) AS mon, COUNT(*) AS cmrc
          FROM main.returns r3 JOIN main.orders o3 ON o3.txnnum = r3.srctxn
          GROUP BY o3.buyerlink, substr(r3.revdate, 1, 7)) m2
      ON m2.cust = o2.buyerlink AND m2.mon = substr(r2.revdate, 1, 7)
    JOIN main.return_charge_rules cr ON
      (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = c2.seg_category)
      AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = r2.return_channel)
      AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = p2.itemcategory)
      AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = (r2.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason'))
      AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = (q2.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
      AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m2.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
      AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m2.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
  ) x WHERE x.rn = 1
) ar ON ar.casenum = r.casenum
WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00032' AND substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-01'
```

The total Return Handling Charge for customer CUS00104 across all its returns in 2025 is **709.50**.

This was computed using the governed `total_return_handling_charge` metric: for each return, the single applying rule was selected by highest specificity (ties broken by lowest rule_id) among rules matching segment, channel, category, primary reason, item condition, and the customer's monthly return count band; returns with no matching rule take the Standard Handling Charge (15.00 + 5.0% of unit value). RHC = flat_charge + charge_pct/100 × unit_value, summed over the customer's 2025 returns and rounded only at the end.

```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE ar.flat_charge END
    + CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.0 ELSE ar.charge_pct END / 100.0 * CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM main.returns r
JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
LEFT JOIN (
```
```sql
  SELECT x.casenum, x.rule_id, x.flat_charge, x.charge_pct FROM (
    SELECT r2.casenum, cr.rule_id, cr.flat_charge, cr.charge_pct,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r2.casenum ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM main.returns r2
    JOIN main.orders o2 ON o2.txnnum = r2.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN main.customers c2 ON c2.profilenum = o2.buyerlink
```

For cases with a Start Month of January 2024, the average Case Wage Assurance Score (CWAS) per case is:

- **H-1B dependent ('Yes')**: 33.77 (59 cases)
- **Non-dependent ('No')**: 42.60 (212 cases)

Non-dependent cases score higher on average. (16 cases with NULL h1bDep are excluded from both averages.)

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.beginday,
    CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1bdep,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(cwas) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(cwas) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM (
  SELECT h1bdep,
    0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
    + 0.3 * CASE wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END AS cwas
  FROM w
  WHERE date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2024-01-01'
) x
```

```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE ar.flat_charge END

         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
```

```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,
```
```sql
    c.h1bdep,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '')::DOUBLE AS offered_amt,
    pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' AS offered_unit,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::DOUBLE AS prev_amt,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' AS prev_unit,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE substr(c.beginday, 4, 2) = '01'
    AND substr(c.beginday, 7, 4) = '2024'
    AND c.h1bdep IN ('Yes', 'No')

scored AS (
  SELECT
    filekey,
    h1bdep,
    offered_amt * CASE offered_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END AS aow,
    prev_amt * CASE prev_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END AS apw,
    wage_level
  FROM base
),
cwas_calc AS (
  SELECT
    filekey,
    h1bdep,
    100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS headroom_pts,
    CASE wage_level

      WHEN 'II' THEN 50
      WHEN 'III' THEN 75
      WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
      ELSE 50
    END AS level_pts
  FROM scored
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN h1bdep = 'Yes' THEN 0.7 * headroom_pts + 0.3 * level_pts END), 2) AS avg_cwas_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN h1bdep = 'No' THEN 0.7 * headroom_pts + 0.3 * level_pts END), 2) AS avg_cwas_no
FROM cwas_calc
```

answer:
The average Return Handling Charge per return for Electronics items returned in February 2025 is **73.65**.

This was computed using the governed RHC definition: for each return, the single applying charge rule (highest specificity, ties by lowest rule_id) determines F (flat_charge) and P (charge_pct), falling back to the Standard Handling Charge (15.00 + 5.0%) when no rule matches; RHC = F + P/100 × unit_value, with the Customer Monthly Return Count band evaluated over all of the customer's returns in that month. The average is the sum of RHC over Electronics returns with revdate in 2025-02 divided by their count, rounded to 2 decimals only at the end.

```sql
SELECT ROUND(
  SUM(CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE ar.flat_charge END
    + CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.0 ELSE ar.charge_pct END / 100.0 * CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE))
  / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_rhc
FROM main.returns r
JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT x.casenum, x.rule_id, x.flat_charge, x.charge_pct, x.specificity FROM (
    SELECT r2.casenum, cr.rule_id, cr.flat_charge, cr.charge_pct,
      (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r2.casenum ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM main.returns r2
    JOIN main.orders o2 ON o2.txnnum = r2.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN main.customers c2 ON c2.profilenum = o2.buyerlink
    JOIN main.products p2 ON p2.itemcode = r2.itemlink

          GROUP BY o3.buyerlink, substr(r3.revdate, 1, 7)) m2

      AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = p2.itemcategory)
      AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = (r2.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason'))
      AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = (q2.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
```

The score is computed per the contract: per-case CWAS = 0.7 × Headroom Points + 0.3 × Level Points, then headcount-weighted (Σ CWAS×headCt / Σ headCt) over the employer's cases in each Start Month (calendar month of `beginday`), rounded to 2 decimals only at reporting.

```sql
WITH w AS (

      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack

)

  ROUND(SUM((0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((w.aow - w.apw) / w.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
       + 0.3 * CASE w.wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END) * w.headct)
  / SUM(w.headct), 2) AS ewas
FROM w
```

Here are the results for Microsoft Corporation's Employer Wage Assurance Score by Start Month:

| Month | EWAS |
|-------|------|
| 2023-12 | 71.45 |
| 2024-01 | 44.05 |
| 2024-06 | 61.14 |

**How it was computed:**
1. **AOW/APW**: Each case's offered wage (`from` field) and prevailing wage (`value` field) were parsed (stripping `$`/`USD` and commas) and annualized using the unit factor (Year ×1, Hour ×2080, etc.).
2. **WHR** = (AOW − APW) / APW per case.
3. **Headroom Points** = 100 × min(max(WHR, 0), 0.40) / 0.40.
4. **Level Points** from the prevailing wage level (I=25, II=50, III=75, IV=100, NULL=50).
5. **CWAS** = 0.7 × Headroom Points + 0.3 × Level Points.
6. **EWAS** per month = Σ(CWAS × headCt) / Σ(headCt), rounded to 2 decimals.

```sql
WITH case_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.filekey,
        c.headCt,
        substr(c.beginDay, 7, 4) || '-' || substr(c.beginDay, 4, 2) as start_month,
        (regexp_replace(regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '\$', ''), ',', ''))::DOUBLE as offered_raw,
        pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' as offered_unit,
        (regexp_replace(regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', ''))::DOUBLE as prevailing_raw,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' as prevailing_unit,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' as pw_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homeFirm = 'Microsoft Corporation'
),
wage_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        start_month,
        headCt,
        offered_raw * CASE offered_unit
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
            WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END as aow,
        prevailing_raw * CASE prevailing_unit
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
            WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END as apw,
        pw_level
    FROM case_data
),
score_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        start_month,
        headCt,
        100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 as headroom_points,
        CASE pw_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
            ELSE 50
        END as level_points
    FROM wage_calc
),
cwas_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        start_month,
        headCt,
        0.7 * headroom_points + 0.3 * level_points as cwas
    FROM score_calc
)
SELECT 
    start_month,
    ROUND(SUM(cwas * headCt) / SUM(headCt), 2) as ewas
FROM cwas_calc
GROUP BY start_month
ORDER BY start_month
```

The computation is verified. For Ernst & Young U.S. LLP's 49 cases with Start Month in 2024 (all headCt=1), the new EWAS (0.6/0.4 weights) is 57.95 vs the current 59.19, a change of **-1.24**.

The change equals 0.1 × Σ((Level Points − Headroom Points) × headCt) / Σ(headCt), which is negative because Headroom Points exceed Level Points on average for this employer's 2024 cases.

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.headct,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
    AND year(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = 2024
),
s AS (
  SELECT headct,
    100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS hp,
    CASE wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END AS lp
  FROM w
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM((0.6*hp + 0.4*lp) * headct) / SUM(headct)
      - SUM((0.7*hp + 0.3*lp) * headct) / SUM(headct), 2) AS score_change
FROM s;
```

answer:
Microsoft Corporation has cases in three Start Months. Its Employer Wage Assurance Score (headcount-weighted CWAS) per month:

| month | ewas |
|-------|------|
| 2023-12 | 71.45 |
| 2024-01 | 44.05 |
| 2024-06 | 61.14 |

The score is computed as EWAS = Σ(CWAS × headCt) / Σ(headCt) over the employer's cases in each Start Month, where CWAS = 0.7 × Headroom Points + 0.3 × Level Points (Headroom Points from the unrounded Wage Headroom Ratio, Level Points I=25/II=50/III=75/IV=100/NULL=50), rounded to 2 decimals only at reporting.

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct, c.beginday,
    date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'Microsoft Corporation'
)
SELECT strftime(start_month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  ROUND(SUM((0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
       + 0.3 * CASE wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END) * headct)
  / SUM(headct), 2) AS ewas
FROM w
GROUP BY start_month
ORDER BY start_month ASC
```

answer:
The result is confirmed. The difference is -1.24 (the new score is lower because the headroom points average is higher than the level points average, and the new weighting gives less weight to headroom).

```sql
WITH case_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.filekey,
        c.headCt,
        (
            CASE (pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END
        ) * (
            REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '')::DOUBLE
        ) AS aow,
        (
            CASE (pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END
        ) * (
            REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::DOUBLE
        ) AS apw,
        (pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level') AS pw_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homeFirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
      AND substr(c.beginDay, 7, 4) = '2024'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        filekey,
        headCt,
        100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS headroom_pts,
        CASE pw_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25.0
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50.0
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75.0
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100.0
            ELSE 50.0
        END AS level_pts
    FROM case_data
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SUM(0.6 * headroom_pts + 0.4 * level_pts) * 1.0 / SUM(headCt))
        -
        (SUM(0.7 * headroom_pts + 0.3 * level_pts) * 1.0 / SUM(headCt)),
    2) AS score_change
FROM scored
```

```sql
        cr.rule_id,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        (
            (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS specificity
    FROM elec_returns e
    JOIN cmrc c ON e.casenum = c.casenum
    JOIN return_charge_rules cr
      ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = e.seg_category)
     AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = e.return_channel)
     AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = e.itemcategory)
     AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = e.primary_reason)
     AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = e.item_condition)
     AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR cr.min_monthly_returns <= c.cmrc_val)
     AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns >= c.cmrc_val)
),
best_rule AS (
    SELECT
        casenum,
        unit_value,
        rule_id,
        flat_charge,
        charge_pct,
        specificity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY casenum ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM rule_matches
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        e.casenum,
        e.unit_value,
        COALESCE(b.flat_charge, 15.0) AS flat_charge,
        COALESCE(b.charge_pct, 5.0) AS charge_pct
    FROM elec_returns e
    LEFT JOIN best_rule b ON e.casenum = b.casenum AND b.rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(flat_charge + (charge_pct / 100.0) * unit_value), 2) AS avg_rhc
FROM final
```

The answer is **-1.24**. The modified weighting (0.6 for Headroom Points, 0.4 for Level Points) reduces Ernst & Young U.S. LLP's EWAS for 2024 by 1.24 points compared to the standard weighting (0.7/0.3).

```sql
WITH case_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.filekey,
        c.headct,
        CAST(replace(replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) as offered_amt,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit') as offered_unit,
        CAST(replace(replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'), 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) as pw_amt,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') as pw_unit,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') as wlevel
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wageTrack = pw.trackno
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
      AND substr(c.beginday, 7, 4) = '2024'
),
computed AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        headct,
        (offered_amt * CASE offered_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END 
         - pw_amt * CASE pw_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END)
        / (pw_amt * CASE pw_unit WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END) as WHR,
        CASE wlevel 
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25.0 
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50.0 
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75.0 
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100.0 
            ELSE 50.0 
        END as LevelPoints
    FROM case_data
),
scored AS (
    SELECT 
        filekey,
        headct,
        0.7 * (100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST(WHR, 0), 0.40) / 0.40) + 0.3 * LevelPoints as CWAS_std,
        0.6 * (100.0 * LEAST(GREATEST(WHR, 0), 0.40) / 0.40) + 0.4 * LevelPoints as CWAS_mod
    FROM computed
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(CWAS_mod * headct) / SUM(headct) - SUM(CWAS_std * headct) / SUM(headct), 2) as score_change
FROM scored
```

answer:
The current EWAS is 59.19 and the new (0.6/0.4-weighted) EWAS is 57.95, so the change is **-1.24**.

The difference arises because shifting weight from Headroom Points to Level Points changes each case's CWAS by 0.1×(Level Points − Headroom Points), and for Ernst & Young U.S. LLP's 49 cases starting in 2024 the headcount-weighted average of that is negative.

```sql
WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.headct,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1 END AS apw
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
    AND year(strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = 2024
),
sc AS (
  SELECT headct,
    100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS hp,
    CASE wage_level WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100 ELSE 50 END AS lp
  FROM w
)
SELECT ROUND(
  SUM((0.6*hp + 0.4*lp) * headct) / SUM(headct)
  - SUM((0.7*hp + 0.3*lp) * headct) / SUM(headct)
, 2) AS diff
FROM sc;
```

The average Return Handling Charge per return for Electronics items returned in February 2025 is **72.70**.

The calculation:
1. Identified 224 Electronics returns in February 2025
2. For each return, computed the Customer Monthly Return Count (CMRC)
3. Matched each return against all charge rules (208 matched a rule, 16 used the Standard Handling Charge default of flat=15.00, pct=5.0)
4. Selected the governing rule by highest specificity (ties broken by lowest rule_id)
5. Computed RHC = flat_charge + (charge_pct/100) × unit_value for each return
6. Averaged all 224 RHC values

**Answer: 179**

I computed the Return Handling Charge (RHC = flat_charge + charge_pct/100 × unit_value) for every return whose `revdate` falls in 2025, applying the Return Handling Charge Schedule:

- **Customer / attributes** joined via `orders.buyerlink` → `customers.seg_category`, `products.itemcategory`, `return_details.reasoning.primary_reason`, and `quality_assessment.condition.item_condition`.
- **CMRC** (Customer Monthly Return Count) computed over the full `returns` table per customer + `YYYY-MM` month.
- **Rule matching**: a rule matches when every non-NULL text criterion equals the return's value (NULL criterion = wildcard; a non-NULL criterion never matches a NULL return value) and the CMRC falls within the `[min, max]` band.
- **Precedence**: highest specificity (count of non-NULL text criteria + 1 if the band is bounded), ties broken by lowest `rule_id`.
- **No match** → Standard Handling Charge (flat 15.00, 5.0%).

Of the 1,500 returns in 2025, 91 fell to the standard charge (max RHC ≈ 114.89, never above 150), and **179** returns carry an RHC above 150.

```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.casenum,
    o.buyerlink AS customer,
    c.seg_category AS customer_segment,
    r.return_channel,
    p.itemcategory AS item_category,
    r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
    qa.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
    p.unit_value AS v,
    substr(r.revdate,1,7) AS month
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
  LEFT JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
  LEFT JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
  WHERE r.revdate LIKE '2025%'
),
all_returns AS (
  SELECT o.buyerlink AS customer, substr(r.revdate,1,7) AS month
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
),
cmrc AS (
  SELECT customer, month, COUNT(*) AS cmrc
  FROM all_returns
  GROUP BY customer, month
),
matched AS (
  SELECT
    b.casenum, b.v, r.rule_id, r.flat_charge, r.charge_pct,
    (CASE WHEN r.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN (r.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR r.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS specificity
  FROM base b
  JOIN cmrc c ON b.customer = c.customer AND b.month = c.month
  JOIN return_charge_rules r
    ON (r.customer_segment IS NULL OR r.customer_segment = b.customer_segment)
    AND (r.return_channel IS NULL OR r.return_channel = b.return_channel)
    AND (r.item_category IS NULL OR r.item_category = b.item_category)
    AND (r.primary_reason IS NULL OR r.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
    AND (r.item_condition IS NULL OR r.item_condition = b.item_condition)
    AND (r.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR r.min_monthly_returns <= c.cmrc)
    AND (r.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR r.max_monthly_returns >= c.cmrc)
),
best AS (
  SELECT casenum, v, flat_charge, charge_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY casenum ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM matched
),
final AS (
  SELECT b.casenum, b.v,
    COALESCE(bst.flat_charge, 15.0) AS flat_charge,
    COALESCE(bst.charge_pct, 5.0) AS charge_pct
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM best WHERE rn = 1) bst ON b.casenum = bst.casenum
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_returns
FROM final
WHERE flat_charge + (charge_pct/100.0) * v > 150
```
